text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about— Tokai Teio 
seemed to be pondering something deeply.
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Actually, the President gave me an 
assignment—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really am a genius, aren't I~♪ I mean, I 
just won this practice race too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My times have been steadily dropping ever 
since I came to the academy. If this keeps 
up—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I might reach "Emperor" status sooner than 
I thought! Right, Prez? Don't you think so 
too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you are, huh... If you don't 
properly assess your current situation, 
that momentum will eventually come to a 
halt."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmh! What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A long road lies ahead... The path to the 
top is steeper and farther than you think. 
There is still much for you to learn.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly wish to become stronger... 
very well. I have an assignment for you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, the assignment they gave me was: "What 
is a Trainer to you?"
choice_data_list: If I can help, I'm happy to!
If you're okay with me, I'll help out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then come with me to just one 
place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was dragged along, more or less against 
my will, to an amusement park. When I 
asked Tokai Teio why—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If we go somewhere we don't usually go 
together, I can learn more about you, 
Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think you'd also totally figure 
out the assignment of "What a Trainer 
means to you"?
choice_data_list: Good idea.
Good idea, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Then let's go straight to 
the go-karts first~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaay♪ I'm number one by a mile!
choice_data_list: Teio's fast even in a go-kart, huh.
Teio's fast even in a go-kart, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mufufu~♪ Race pacing is second nature to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Point the gun controller at the screen and 
shoot the carrots as they appear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll show you how it's done! 
...Bang-bang♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How's that?!
choice_data_list: Incredible! Every single one hit the mark!
Amazing! Every single one hit the mark!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shucks... maybe I am that great~! Lady 
Teio is invincible even with a gun, after 
all♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We went around to various other 
attractions after that, and before we knew 
it, the sun was sinking low in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was so much fun~♪ So, 
Trainer-kun, did you get a good look at my 
skills?
choice_data_list: Every single one was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, if only we had more time, I could've 
shown off even more brilliant techniques~.
choice_data_list: Maybe another time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's hang out again! Playing with 
you was so much fun, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since you praised me just like in 
training, my hype levels shot totally 
through the roof!
choice_data_list:
You keep things so entertaining, I just 
couldn't help myself.

You keep things so entertaining, I just 
couldn't help myself.

I can't help it when you always live up to 
my expectations.

I can't help it since you always live up 
to my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since you praised me just like in 
training, my hype levels shot totally 
through the roof!
choice_data_list:
You keep things so entertaining, I just 
couldn't help myself.

You keep things so entertaining, I just 
couldn't help myself.

I can't help it when you always live up to 
my expectations.

I can't help it since you always live up 
to my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her running during races, and her 
cheerful nature in daily life. Tokai Teio 
always brings joy to everyone around her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just watching Tokai Teio brings a smile to 
my face too. When I told her that was why 
I felt like praising her—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When you say that much, even I can't help 
but blush! Geez~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ In that case, I'll make sure to 
give you even more fun from now on, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, though, what Trainer means to 
me, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(What I learned today is that they're the 
kind of person who always heaps praise on 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a warm, fuzzy feeling in our hearts, 
Tokai Teio and I left the amusement park 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether in running or at the amusement 
park, the more praise she gets, the more 
Tokai Teio rises to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When I explained that it was precisely 
because I praised her in anticipation of 
seeing something even more magnificent—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You're surprisingly greedy, 
Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Well, maybe I'm the only one who can live 
up to a Trainer like that!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'll live up to your 
expectations even more from now on♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, though, what Trainer means to 
me, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(What I learned today is that they're the 
kind of person who always heaps praise on 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a warm, fuzzy feeling in our hearts, 
Tokai Teio and I left the amusement park 
behind.
